expect.detail: no claudinite-scheduler.yml on the default branch, or Actions is disabled — nothing there can run its own tasks

dispatching a workflow was refused — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Actions: read and write (the two fan-out sweeps dispatch another member's scheduler workflow, which is an Actions write)

the workflow exists but refused the dispatch (422) — either its scheduler workflow predates the `wake` input, which its next update lands, or GitHub has disabled it (cron is switched off on inactive repos)
